name: dataset set
definition: The set of evaluated fraud datasets: D1_creditcard, D2_fraudTest, and D3_PaySim.

name: model set
definition: The model families evaluated in the audit: LightGBM and XGBoost.

name: seed set
definition: The random seeds used for repeated evaluation: 42, 101, 202, 303, and 404.

name: audit-axis set
definition: The LC-ORF axes: leakage, temporal, prevalence, calibration, explanation_protocol, alert_budget, and explanation_reliability_gap.

name: scenario set
definition: The reference and perturbed evaluation scenarios associated with audit axis a.

name: metric set
definition: The measured metrics: average_precision, MCC, precision, recall, Brier score, ECE, and cost_per_10k.

name: reference scenario
definition: The baseline scenario in a scenario pair, such as SAFE_STRICT or RANDOM_STRATIFIED_SAFE.

name: perturbed scenario
definition: The shifted or stressed scenario in a scenario pair, such as UNSAFE_SMOTE_BEFORE_SPLIT or CHRONOLOGICAL_SAFE.

name: metric functional
definition: The function that maps labels, scores, and the decision threshold to metric k.

name: decision threshold
definition: The cost-sensitive threshold selected on validation predictions and reused on the corresponding test stream.

name: scenario delta
definition: The perturbed-minus-reference metric change: Delta = Q_k(c1) - Q_k(c0).

name: bootstrap count
definition: The number of bootstrap replicates used for interval estimation; B = 1000 in the final LC-ORF audit.

name: bootstrap interval
definition: The percentile bootstrap interval using the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of bootstrap deltas.

name: top-k explanation overlap
definition: The top-k Jaccard agreement between explanation feature rankings under compared protocols.

name: explanation instability index
definition: One minus the mean top-k Jaccard agreement; higher values indicate less stable explanation rankings.

name: explanation reliability gap
definition: A proxy equal to AP fragility units minus EII, used to flag disagreement between predictive fragility and explanation-rank instability.
